question: On Motion to Concur in the Senate Amendments — An Act to amend the Internal Revenue Code of 1986 to allow early childhood educators to take the educator expense deduction, and for other purposes (H R 5334)
bill_title: Lindsey O. Graham Sanctioning Russia and Iran Act of 2026
plain_language: The House voted to accept the Senate's rewrite of H.R. 5334, which imposes Russia-related sanctions and tariffs, extends an Iran sanctions law, and also expands a teacher tax deduction to early-childhood educators. A Yea accepts that Senate version. A Nay rejects it.

question: On Agreeing to the Resolution — Directing the President, pursuant to section 5(c) of the War Powers Resolution, to remove United States Armed Forces from hostilities with Iran (H CON RES 93)
bill_title: Directing the President, pursuant to section 5(c) of the War Powers Resolution, to remove United States Armed Forces from hostilities with Iran.
plain_language: This resolution tells the President to remove U.S. forces from hostilities with Iran unless Congress authorizes it, except for forces needed to defend against an imminent attack if the President follows the War Powers Resolution's time limits. A Yea agrees. A Nay rejects it.

question: On Agreeing to the Resolution — Directing the President, pursuant to section 5(c) of the War Powers Resolution, to remove United States Armed Forces from hostilities with Iran (H CON RES 89)
bill_title: Directing the President, pursuant to section 5(c) of the War Powers Resolution, to remove United States Armed Forces from hostilities with Iran.
plain_language: This resolution tells the President to remove U.S. forces from hostilities with Iran unless Congress has declared war or authorized that force, while still allowing defense against an imminent attack. A Yea agrees to that direction. A Nay rejects it.

question: On Agreeing to the Resolution — Directing the President pursuant to section 5(c) of the War Powers Resolution to remove United States Armed Forces from hostilities in Lebanon (H CON RES 108)
bill_title: Directing the President pursuant to section 5(c) of the War Powers Resolution to remove United States Armed Forces from hostilities in Lebanon.
plain_language: This concurrent resolution directs the President to remove U.S. Armed Forces from hostilities in Lebanon within seven days of the resolution's adoption. A Yea agrees to the concurrent resolution; a Nay opposes it.

question: On Passage — Ukraine Support Act (H R 2913)
plain_language: This bill addresses the war between Russia and Ukraine by (1) providing assistance to Ukraine and certain European countries, and (2) establishing penalties for Russia and certain foreign persons (individuals and entities). A Yea supports passing it in the House; a Nay opposes it.

question: On Agreeing to the Resolution — Directing the President pursuant to section 5(c) of the War Powers Resolution to remove United States Armed Forces from Lebanon (H CON RES 84)
bill_title: Directing the President pursuant to section 5(c) of the War Powers Resolution to remove United States Armed Forces from Lebanon.
plain_language: This concurrent resolution directs the President to remove U.S. Armed Forces from Lebanon within seven days of the resolution's adoption. A Yea agrees to the concurrent resolution; a Nay opposes it.

question: On Agreeing to the Resolution — Directing the President, pursuant to section 5(c) of the War Powers Resolution, to remove United States Armed Forces from hostilities with Iran (H CON RES 86)
bill_title: Directing the President, pursuant to section 5(c) of the War Powers Resolution, to remove United States Armed Forces from hostilities with Iran.
plain_language: This concurrent resolution directs the President to remove U.S. Armed Forces from hostilities against Iran unless explicitly authorized by a declaration of war or a congressional authorization for use of military force against Iran. A Yea agrees to the concurrent resolution; a Nay opposes it.

question: On Agreeing to the Resolution — Directing the President, pursuant to section 5(c) of the War Powers Resolution, to remove the United States Armed Forces from hostilities against the Islamic Republic of Iran (H CON RES 75)
bill_title: Directing the President, pursuant to section 5(c) of the War Powers Resolution, to remove the United States Armed Forces from hostilities against the Islamic Republic of Iran.
plain_language: This concurrent resolution directs the President to remove U.S. Armed Forces from hostilities against Iran or any part of its government or military no later than March 30, 2026, unless a declaration of war or authorization to use military force for such purpose has been enacted. A Yea agrees to the concurrent resolution; a Nay opposes it.

question: On Passage — To require the Secretary of Homeland Security to designate Haiti for temporary protected status (H R 1689)
bill_title: To require the Secretary of Homeland Security to designate Haiti for temporary protected status.
plain_language: This bill directs the Department of Homeland Security to designate Haiti for temporary protected status for 18 months beginning August 3, 2025. A Yea supports passing it in the House; a Nay opposes it.

bill_title: Directing the President, pursuant to section 5(c) of the War Powers Resolution, to remove United States Armed Forces from hostilities with Iran.
plain_language: This concurrent resolution directs the President to remove U.S. Armed Forces from hostilities against Iran unless explicitly authorized by a declaration of war or a congressional authorization for use of military force against Iran. A Yea agrees to the concurrent resolution; a Nay opposes it.

question: On Agreeing to the Resolution — Directing the President pursuant to section 5(c) of the War Powers Resolution to remove United States Armed Forces from unauthorized hostilities in the Islamic Republic of Iran (H CON RES 38)
bill_title: Directing the President pursuant to section 5(c) of the War Powers Resolution to remove United States Armed Forces from unauthorized hostilities in the Islamic Republic of Iran.
plain_language: This concurrent resolution directs the President to terminate the use of U.S. Armed Forces from hostilities against Iran or any part of the Iranian government or military unless a declaration of war or authorization to use military force for such purpose has been enacted. A Yea agrees to the concurrent resolution; a Nay opposes it.

question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Agree — Reaffirming Iran remains the largest state sponsor of terrorism (H RES 1099)
bill_title: Reaffirming Iran remains the largest state sponsor of terrorism.
plain_language: This resolution states that the House of Representatives declares it is the policy of the United States that Iran continues to be the largest state sponsor of terrorism. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports agreeing to it; a Nay opposes it.

question: On Motion to Suspend the Rules and Pass, as Amended — PROTECT Taiwan Act (H R 1531)
plain_language: This bill requires certain federal entities to seek to exclude China from six international financial organizations if the President informs Congress that China's actions threaten Taiwan and pose a danger to U.S. interests. This vote was under suspension of the rules, so a two-thirds vote was required. A Yea supports passing it as amended; a Nay opposes it.

question: On Agreeing to the Resolution — To direct the removal of United States Armed Forces from Venezuela that have not been authorized by Congress (H CON RES 68)
bill_title: To direct the removal of United States Armed Forces from Venezuela that have not been authorized by Congress.
plain_language: This concurrent resolution directs the President to remove U.S. Armed Forces from Venezuela unless a declaration of war or authorization to use military force for such purpose has been enacted. A Yea agrees to the concurrent resolution; a Nay opposes it.
